text.text_excerpt: I just love going here for Jeremy Davenport. Great vibe, the place looks like a fancy living room complete with fab smelling candles, comfy couches, and mixed nuts served with you cocktails. The music is old jazz standards, and the dance floor is small but romantic. But truth be told, one of those couches is the exact spot where I first fell in love with my now fiance, so this place is kinda special to me. The prices on the drinks are a bit steep but the show is free so, sip one slowly , dance and enjoy.

I love this place! We came in here during December right before I moved away and its adorable! It was the first bar we came back to at nighttime upon my return to visit New Orleans. Per the name, its decorated as an old library...its a members only cigar bar, with plenty of tables and cozy chairs, with an extremely cozy feeling. There's a piano which occasionally they play, and the bartender is one of the best i've encountered in NOLA! The muddled berry vodka drink (not sure the name, he just whipped it up for us per saying i liked strong drinks and vodka) was amazing! They also had free champagne for a champagne tasting (always a good sign in my book as i loveee champagne!) The clientele...

A great place to listen to the standards in a comfortable, non-smoky environment. Although this place is pretty spacious, it was also very popular on the night we went to listen to Jeremy Davenport and his uber-cool band. There was not one open seat to be found during his set as folks were milling about sipping cocktails, kicking up their heels and snapping their fingers to the classics. My group ended up sitting in the dining area which is right behind the lounge. We could still see the stage, sit comfortably at a table, sip a few cocktails and enjoy the music. The best part was that the music was not so loud that we could not hear one another. Drinks and food are on the pricey side, but...
